seniority.evidence: 6.4 total years across Bunnings Warehouse (March 2024–present, ~2.3 yrs) and Coles Supermarket (Jan 2020–Feb 2024, ~4.1 yrs) — both are casual retail roles with zero functional overlap to Laboratory Technician (Biochemistry) or any clinical/healthcare discipline. Bachelor of Biomedical Science completed 2023 (La Trobe). Cover letter confirms 'I don't have any lab experience outside of uni.' Zero relevant_years → Junior regardless of total duration.

style_patterns.sentence_structure: Short gerund or bare noun fragments; one casual run-on sentence
style_patterns.voice_descriptor: Telegraphic casual gerund fragments and bare noun phrases, proximity-framed with zero quantification — reads like informal shorthand rather than a professional document. Cover letter compounds this with a self-deprecating, hedge-heavy voice that pre-empts rejection before the reader has formed a view.
writing_weaknesses: no metrics or outcomes anywhere in CV
gerund-led bullets throughout instead of past-tense action verbs
casual register across CV and cover letter
skills section is entirely filler clichés with no substantive claims
self-deprecating cover letter actively undermines the application

signature_phrases.intent: none — voice too weak to seed

persuasion_strategy.proof: I know I probably don't have as much experience as other people applying but I am a quick learner and I am good at following instructions

examples: sometimes worked in the deli when they needed people

flagged_issues.description: Casual conversational narration in a work history bullet — unprofessional for any formal job application
flagged_issues.original: sometimes worked in the deli when they needed people
flagged_issues.suggested: Rotated to deli counter to support operational requirements across departments

flagged_issues.description: Self-deprecating opener in cover letter pre-empts rejection and signals lack of confidence before the reader has formed a view
flagged_issues.original: I know I probably don't have as much experience as other people applying but I am a quick learner and I am good at following instructions
flagged_issues.suggested: My Bachelor of Biomedical Science (La Trobe University, 2023) provided hands-on laboratory training in biochemical techniques, and I bring a strong attention to detail developed across high-volume customer-facing roles.

flagged_issues.description: Overly casual personal remark in cover letter — inappropriate in a clinical/professional application context
flagged_issues.original: I never call in sick unless I actually am
flagged_issues.suggested: I maintain a strong attendance record and bring consistent reliability to every role I undertake.

flagged_issues.description: Instruction-following is a baseline expectation, not a marketable skill — signals low professional self-awareness
flagged_issues.suggested: Remove or replace with a substantive transferable claim — e.g. 'Accurate data recording and attention to procedural compliance' to bridge to lab work

flagged_issues.description: Overused cliché with no evidential backing — recruiters discount this entirely
flagged_issues.suggested: Remove or replace with evidence-backed phrasing — e.g. 'Collaborated across garden, hardware, and trade departments in a team of 8'

flagged_issues.description: Unsubstantiated trait — carries no weight without a supporting example or metric
flagged_issues.suggested: Remove — reliability is better demonstrated implicitly by length of tenure (4 years at Coles) than asserted in a skills list

flagged_issues.description: Bare noun phrase describing a work area with no task, responsibility, or outcome — reads like an afterthought
flagged_issues.suggested: Managed stock rotation and product placement across the garden department, maintaining correct labelling and shelf availability

flagged_issues.description: Gerund-led bullets used throughout the entire CV — present-participle construction is weak and non-standard; past-tense action verbs are expected in professional work history
flagged_issues.suggested: Assisted customers in locating products across garden, hardware, and trade departments

flagged_issues.description: Email handle includes birth year and uses a legacy domain — signals a personal rather than professional digital identity
flagged_issues.suggested: Update to a professional address, e.g. sarah.jenkins@gmail.com
